slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video, object-cover, autoplay muted playsInline, playbackRate 1, sits behind nav/title/card at zIndex 0.

Split-screen product-panel side videos (ScentFinder right column, WildScent left column), object-cover over a #111 block; desktop fills a 1fr grid column, mobile collapses to a 75vw fixed-height strip. Two distinct clips, same socket role.

Floating/inline hero product-card bottle shot (Eau So Fresh). Rendered objectFit:contain inside a small rounded ~60x76px box, overscaled to 130% with -15% top/left offset, on a white card — needs a transparent/clean-background packshot.

Product-panel bottle shots (Eau So Sweet, Eau So Extra), objectFit:cover into a fixed 220/340 portrait box (width clamp(140px,40%,220px)) on a #D9D9D9 placeholder block. Off-ratio art will crop. Two images, same socket role.

mechanic: A full-bleed looping hero video with timed staggered translate-and-fade reveals of the nav, headline and product card, scrolling into two split-screen color-block-plus-video product panels that fade-and-rise in on IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.15).
techDelivery: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3 (stock config, default breakpoints) starter; lucide-react available but unused, @supabase/supabase-js a dependency; all motion is inline-style CSS transitions via an anim() helper (no animation library), not a single-file CDN build.
reskinNotes: HERO_TEXT (#332023) is a second baked-in foreground used across the hero, distinct from fg #000000, and the muted desktop headline color #B0A2A1 is hardcoded — reskinning the hero requires overriding these, not just fg. The hero packshot is overscaled 130% with a -15% offset, so framing is metric-dependent. All copy is hardcoded in JSX markup, including the literal '01' slide numeral, the perfume ingredient note strings, and brand name; the headline and product card are duplicated as separate mobile (block sm:hidden, white-with-textShadow) and desktop (hidden sm:block) span sets, so each copy string must be edited in two places. Panel images live in a fixed 220/340 box on a solid color block, so non-portrait art crops/letterboxes.
